access.title: Voice access
access.description: Off by default. While it is off, commands work exactly as before: the speaker mark is not read and the Speaker ID add-on is not contacted. Turn it on to limit who can control which devices. The password and the add-on address are optional. You can type names yourself.

data_description.access_control_enabled: Leave this off if you do not need per-person limits.
data_description.access_shared_secret: The same password as in the Speaker ID add-on. Leave empty if you only map Home Assistant users.
data_description.access_addon_url: Optional. Example: http://local-wyoming-speaker-id:8099/api/people. A wrong password answers 401 and the names you typed are used instead. Leave empty if the add-on is not installed.
data_description.access_min_confidence: 0 accepts any signed voice. Raise it, for example to 0.6, to treat a weak match as unknown.
data_description.access_none_reply: Spoken when this person may not use the assistant. Leave empty to stay silent.
data_description.access_manual_people: One name per line. Used when the add-on is missing or unreachable.

access_menu.title: Who can control what
access_menu.description: Create device groups, then choose a level for each person.

access_class_pick.title: Device groups
access_class_pick.description: A group is a set of devices, rooms, or labels. A person set to Selected groups can use only the groups you pick.

access_class_edit.title: Device group
access_class_edit.description: Pick individual entities, whole devices, rooms, or labels. A person allowed this group can use everything in it.

access_rules.title: People
access_rules.description: Nothing: the assistant stays silent or says the reply you set. Selected groups: only those groups. Everything: no limit. A person with no row can do everything until you set a level. Unknown voice covers guests and failed recognition.

data_description.access_manual_people: One name per line. Save to give each new name a level. The add-on is not required.

access_users.title: App users
access_users.description: Typed messages in the Home Assistant app have no voice mark. Map each user to a person. Unknown uses the unknown-voice level.

data_description.access_user_lines: One line per user: user id = person name. Leave a user out to treat them as unknown.
